# planetscale_neki_routers (Data Source)

NekiRouters DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "planetscale_neki_routers" "my_nekirouters" {
  branch       = "...my_branch..."
  database     = "...my_database..."
  organization = "...my_organization..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) Branch name from `list_branches`. Example: `main`.
- `database` (String) Database name slug from `list_databases`. Example: `app-db`.
- `organization` (String) Organization name slug from `list_organizations`. Example: `acme`.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) Returns routers for the branch (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `autoscaling` (Boolean) Whether the router scales horizontally within each cell
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default router
- `id` (String) The ID of the router
- `max_replicas_per_cell` (Number) The maximum count of replicas in each cell when autoscaling
- `name` (String) The name of the router
- `replicas_per_cell` (Number) The count of replicas in each cell
- `router_size` (String) The router size SKU name
- `state` (String) The current state of the router
- `target_cpu_utilization` (Number) The target average CPU utilization percentage when autoscaling, one of 40, 50, 60 or 70
